lex:
ἀντι-τάσσω (Att..., -ττω)
[in LXX for לוּץ hi., נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
to range on battle against; mid., to set oneself against, resist: absol., Act.18:6; with dative, Rom.13:2, Jas.4:6 5:6, 1Pe.5:5 (MM, VGT, see word).†

strongs.def: to range oneself against, i.e. oppose
strongs.from: from G473 (ἀντί) and the middle voice of G5021 (τάσσω)
